drifted.actual: The drop counter (eviction_dropped.fetch_add) lives ONLY inside emit_eviction, which is #[allow(dead_code)] with no call sites (lib.rs:228-236). Every live eviction publish site uses a bare `let _ = tx.try_send(...)` that discards the Err without incrementing: evict_for_space_* inline (lib.rs:603-607,619-623,634-645); BackgroundEvictor::evictor_loop (background.rs:414-419); MemoryTierEvictor::evictor_loop (background.rs:611-616). So eviction_dropped_count() (lib.rs:224-226) always returns 0. Channel/try_send/non-blocking/silent-drop parts are correct; only the drop-count guarantee is unmet.
drifted.resolution: ALIGN (code fix, tracked in align-tasks.md; not applied by sync)
